verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents a custom report builder covering candidates, sources, departments, jobs, offers, openings and custom fields, with advanced filtering, boolean search and AI-powered report filters. Getting data out is only indirectly evidenced: webhooks fire on application and candidate events, and the general API page lists candidate and application operations (largely write-side). None of this is described as a reporting or warehouse export path. missing for 10: scheduled report exports, BI connectors or a warehouse sync, a documented bulk-read reporting API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
